name: demandbase
description: Connect AI agents to Demandbase: ask natural-language questions about your accounts, people, opportunities, engagement, intent, and buying groups, plus Demandbase's global B2B intelligence (firmographics, technographics, corporate hierarchy, news). Read-only and respects your existing Demandbase permissions. The account intelligence layer for Codex and any MCP-compatible agent.

interface.shortDescription: Account intelligence for AI agents: ask about your accounts, people, intent, and buying groups in Demandbase.
interface.longDescription: Demandbase MCP gives AI agents read-only access to your Demandbase tenant and Demandbase's global B2B intelligence. Ask natural-language questions about accounts, people, opportunities, engagement, intent, and buying-group coverage, and look up firmographics, technographics, corporate hierarchy, news, and employment information. Access is authenticated through your Demandbase sign-in (OAuth) and respects your existing Demandbase permissions. Use cases: account research, account-based marketing, pipeline review, intent-driven prioritization, buying-group analysis, and meeting prep.
defaultPrompt: Which of my accounts are showing the highest intent this month?
